with-um.contextReadOutcome: Both get_context calls returned no runs, records or updates; no open_process or save_update calls occurred.

result: Both arms reached the same correct defer decision. UM additionally supplied editable assumptions, an executable recalculation model and source-row classification. Independent copy-only replay and sensitivity checks support a specific reusable-artifact benefit in this case; no aggregate quality lift claim.
limitations: One author-visible synthetic case, not an independent holdout or estimate of aggregate causal lift.
No customer account, live provider action, external research or browser journey was tested.
No open_process or save_update call occurred; cross-agent memory benefit remains untested.
Gross tokens include repeated cached input and are not monetary cost.
Current local candidate catalog has added standalone mappings and does not prove production visibility.
UM decision note is a manual snapshot and must be updated after recalculation.
UM script has fixed date/horizon labels and lacks general month-order/assumption-range validation.
UM used more gross/uncached tokens and elapsed time in this case.
redactionNotes: Raw fictional source files and performer output files under arms/ are byte-identical; no redactions were necessary.
